scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:amplify
scripts.test:auth: tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.test.json && tsx --tsconfig frontend/tsconfig.test.json --test frontend/tests/auth.test.tsx frontend/tests/authFlows.test.ts
scripts.test:audio: tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.test.json && tsx --tsconfig frontend/tsconfig.test.json --test frontend/tests/audioStorage.test.ts frontend/tests/recordAudio.test.ts
